newey_west_lag_bugfix.description: generate_tables_figures.py's own inline portfolio-regression helper (_run_inline_factor_reg) called newey_west_ols(y, X, max_lags=NW_LAGS) with NW_LAGS hardcoded to 4, but analysis_v2.py's run_factor_regressions() -- the function identification_battery.py / robustness_diagnostics.py / exclude_amazon_robustness.py all use for the canonical baseline -- calls newey_west_ols(y, X) with no max_lags, letting it fall through to the Newey-West (1994) automatic-bandwidth rule (4*(T/100)**(2/9), which evaluates to 3 for this sample). This produced alphas, R-squareds and N that matched the canonical baseline exactly, but standard errors that silently did not (e.g. baseline ADJ RRR FF3: SE=0.6433 vs canonical 0.6533, t implied 2.98 vs canonical 2.94). Found by hand-verifying tab_headline_summary.tex against identification_battery.xlsx's T1_QMJ_BAB sheet. Fixed by removing the max_lags override; re-verified the fix reproduces the canonical SE (0.6533/0.6556) exactly across every affected table (tab_portfolio_alphas_raw/adj, tab_portfolio_alphas_ar_raw/adj, tab_robustness_nocovid/ew, tab_placebo, tab_headline_summary, tab_robustness_consolidated, tab_sorr).

run_inline_factor_reg_column_bugfix.description: _run_inline_factor_reg() hardcoded portfolio_cols = [c for c in ['Q1','Q2','Q3','Q4','Q1-Q4'] if c in port.columns], so any caller with differently-named portfolio columns (port_placebo_m: High/Low/High-Low) matched nothing and returned an empty results dict with no error -- _build_panel_table() then silently rendered every cell of tab_placebo.tex blank. Fixed by auto-detecting portfolio_cols as every column except MKT (verified equivalent to the old hardcoded list for every Q1-Q4 caller); the zero-cost-spread RF-subtraction check was generalized from `== 'Q1-Q4'` to `'-' in port_col` for the same reason.

known_gaps.paper_latex_not_git_tracked: Paper_LaTeX/ (containing tables/ and figures/) is a SIBLING of Code/RRR-FI-IM under RRR_FinancialImplication/, not a subdirectory of it, so it is outside the Code/RRR-FI-IM git repo's root and cannot be included in commits made there. RRR_FinancialImplication/ itself has no .git of its own. The only git repository that could see Paper_LaTeX/ files is a very broad repository rooted at C:\Users\thkraft (the user's home directory), which was not touched -- it appears to be a general/unmanaged repo covering unrelated personal directories, not a curated project repo, and committing this paper's LaTeX output into it without being asked seemed like the wrong call. Practical effect: every .tex table file listed below is new/updated on disk (and, if this project relies on Dropbox's own version history for Paper_LaTeX, backed by that instead of git) but not captured in any git commit made during Stage 5. Flagged for the author to resolve -- e.g. by git-initializing Paper_LaTeX or extending the Code/RRR-FI-IM repo's root -- rather than guessing.
known_gaps.four_quarter_trailing_rrr_lr_rrr: Ported forward from an already-computed panel column (ADJ_LR_RRR_PCT) that pre-existed in build_holding_panel()'s alt_cols; the portfolio sort and factor regression were completed in generate_tables_figures.py itself (not one of the five locked analytical scripts) and persisted to output/lr_rrr_robustness_stage5.xlsx for traceability. This is the one number in the deliverable that was computed by the presentation-stage script rather than pulled pre-computed, per the task's explicit 'port forward if straightforward' instruction for this specific robustness variant.
